The '''Dead Bush of Love''' is a {{Special}} item. Players (Staff + Hypixel Player Council) who helped test [[Hypixel SkyBlock]] before its public release received this item as a token of gratitude. Only a few players were given this opportunity, which is why this item is extremely rare.

== Trivia ==
* This item was last seen on the [[Auction House]] in January 2021.
** The item was seen with a 1 billion coin bid, however it was later reported as a guild transfer, and the money and items were later returned.
** The last time one was sold on the Auction House, it was a joke bid by xTear on MeltedMagma's auction and all money was later returned.
** Currently, Doblox912 has two of them on his museum profile Pear.
* The name "Bush of Love" may come from the popular song "[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RySHDUU2juM Bushes of Love]" by "Bad Lip Reading" on YouTube.
* The last pink Dead Bush of Love before the {{Special}} rarity color change was given to Alienator5000 (BernieSander previously) and was placed in an item frame on CookieNoRookie's island with the original pink color. However, it was later sold and turned into the recent red color.
